nodes.summary: Initializes serial logging, configures ADC1 sensor pins, and connects WiFi telemetry.

nodes.name: loop
nodes.summary: Drives the non-blocking network loop and periodically polls ADC sensor readings to publish telemetry to Nodrix.

nodes.name: sensors.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements ADC initialization and physical magnitude calculation with per-sample range and validity verification.

nodes.name: read_scaled_channel
nodes.summary: Samples raw ADC channel value, scales it linearly to physical units, and verifies sanity bounds.

nodes.name: sensors_init
nodes.summary: Configures ESP32 ADC1 resolution to 12 bits, attenuation to 11 dB, and sets up GPIO input pins for sensor channels.

nodes.name: sensors_read
nodes.summary: Reads and validates raw 12-bit values from ADC1 channels and returns structured SensorData.

nodes.name: sensors.h
nodes.summary: Header declaring sensor data structures (SensorReading with validity flag, SensorData) and function prototypes for ADC setup and sampling.

nodes.name: telemetry.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements IoT telemetry communication using the Nodrix SDK over WebSockets and fast WiFi association, with per-metric validation and optional Root CA pinning.
nodes.languageNotes: Integrates decoded-cipher/Nodrix library with channel-6 fast association and non-blocking WebSocket loop maintenance.

nodes.name: connect_wifi_fast
nodes.summary: Connects to WiFi with an optimized channel 6 scan for Wokwi-GUEST and fallback scanning for standard networks.

nodes.name: telemetry_init
nodes.summary: Configures TLS mode (Root CA pinning or development insecure), initializes WiFi connection, and starts the Nodrix client session.

nodes.name: telemetry_run
nodes.summary: Drives the non-blocking Nodrix client event loop to maintain WebSocket frames and handle background network events.

nodes.name: telemetry_is_connected
nodes.summary: Checks active connectivity status via the Nodrix WebSocket client or WiFi interface.

nodes.name: telemetry_publish
nodes.summary: Staged sensor readings are individually validated and batched through Nodrix.send() and Nodrix.flush().

nodes.name: telemetry.h
nodes.summary: Header defining public telemetry interface functions for WiFi initialization, network maintenance, and sensor data dispatch.

tour.title: Architecture & Project Overview
tour.description: Start with README.md to understand the complete sensorica_blueprint system architecture spanning simulated sensing, ESP32 ADC digitization, and Cloudflare Nodrix cloud telemetry with Root CA verification. It details the end-to-end data pipeline, repository structure, and physical channel mapping.
tour.languageLesson: Markdown documents with embedded Mermaid diagrams allow architectural blueprints to evolve synchronously with code in version control.

tour.title: Signal Conditioning & Circuit Setup
tour.description: Before reading firmware code, understand how hardware signals are acquired and simulated. These files document analog front-end conditioning constraints—explaining why ESP32 ADC1 is strictly chosen over ADC2 to coexist with WiFi—and map virtual potentiometers to GPIOs in the Wokwi circuit layout.
tour.languageLesson: Wokwi diagram.json declarations model breadboard wiring, component part numbers, and pin connections for deterministic simulation without physical lab hardware.

tour.title: Build Configuration & Emulation
tour.description: Connecting the circuit simulation to compilation, these configuration files define the PlatformIO build environment and Wokwi runtime bridge. They specify the Espressif 32 platform, Arduino framework, upload speed, and the compiled binary targets executed in the emulator.
tour.languageLesson: PlatformIO uses INI-formatted platformio.ini files to isolate target microcontrollers, framework versions, and external library dependencies.

tour.title: Firmware Parameters & Credentials
tour.description: Building on the hardware definitions from Step 2, config.h defines ADC1 pin constants, actuator pins, physical magnitude conversion boundaries, and telemetry dispatch intervals. The secrets template provides secure placeholders for WiFi credentials, Nodrix Cloudflare endpoints, and Root CA certificate pinning.
tour.languageLesson: Header guards (#ifndef / #define) prevent duplicate symbol declarations in C/C++, while .example template files prevent accidental commits of production secrets.

tour.title: ADC Acquisition & Conversion
tour.description: This core module implements the 12-bit ADC digitization, linear scaling, and per-sample sanity validation logic defined in config.h. It declares the SensorReading and SensorData structures, providing clean, strongly typed representations of temperature, humidity, and illumination with error flags.
tour.languageLesson: C++ structs encapsulate multi-channel sensor readings into cohesive data objects, separating hardware acquisition logic from networking code.

tour.title: Network Transport & Telemetry
tour.description: With sensor readings structured in Step 5, the telemetry subsystem manages WiFi connectivity and cloud delivery via the Nodrix SDK. It uses fast channel-6 AP association for Wokwi, drives non-blocking WebSockets, validates sensor metrics individually, and supports TLS Root CA pinning.
tour.languageLesson: Using official SDKs with persistent WebSocket connections eliminates repeated TLS handshakes, reducing CPU cycles and memory overhead on resource-constrained microcontrollers.

tour.title: Main Firmware Application Loop
tour.description: The main entry point ties together sensor sampling from Step 5 and telemetry dispatch from Step 6. Operating inside Arduino's setup and loop lifecycle, it initializes hardware, periodically captures sensor data, drives the non-blocking Nodrix loop, and recovers gracefully from transient link drops.
tour.languageLesson: Non-blocking time comparisons using millis() allow embedded applications to schedule periodic tasks without halting CPU execution via delay().

tour.title: Real-Time Telemetry Dashboard
tour.description: Completing the end-to-end architecture introduced in Step 1, this step covers the Cloudflare Nodrix visualization dashboard. It specifies widget coordinates, historical time-series charts, and gauge monitors bound to the sensor variables emitted by the ESP32 firmware.
tour.languageLesson: Declarative JSON layouts define frontend widget geometries and API data mappings cleanly separated from presentation rendering logic.
